title: Bring the Biased-Decisions and Hard-Decisions sites onto anth.us
description: Serve the Biased-Decisions leaderboard and the Hard-Decisions benchmark from anth.us (/biased-decisions/, /hard-decisions/) instead of their own subdomains, built from their repos at pinned commits by the Anth.us CI, with a benchmarks page and menu entry, sitemap and robots entries, and the subdomains redirecting to the new paths (AWS side). Hard-Decisions source repo is not reachable from this session yet.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Biased-Decisions half merged to develop as PR #72 (561816e), with Biased-Decisions PR #130 (redirect stubs honor BASE_PATH) merged upstream and pinned at f678f54. CI builds the leaderboard into /biased-decisions/ with a 1,112-page sitemap; amplify.yml builds it too for the Git-connected app. /benchmarks/ page and menu entry added. Reviewer: REQUEST_CHANGES (amplify.yml) then APPROVE. Remaining: Hard-Decisions repo access (not visible to the Claude GitHub app); promote develop to main and run the ship gate on https://anth.us/biased-decisions/; 301 biased-decisions.anth.us to anth.us/biased-decisions/ (AWS); Biased-Decisions promotes its develop to main so the pin can move to a released commit. Provenance: claude-code / claude-opus-5-5.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Analytics parity: the leaderboard uses the main site's GA4 property G-31SC26SDGX. Anth.us-Papyrus PR #5 (merged at d76e9b1 into feature/anthus-integration) strips the leaderboard's GA scripts in guarded (staging) builds to match the port's production-only analytics. Checked on 1,532 pages: 1,114 cleaned, other scripts unchanged. Reviewer sub-agent approved.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Launch prep: Anth.us-Papyrus PR #6 merged feature/anthus-integration into develop (f9016d7), carrying all content and site updates (content pin 0cf89c7).
